Senses.Explanation: Literally a nest or mortar; in the Chan record, a fixed mould into which words and conduct settle. The corpus speaks of falling into another's rut (墮他窠臼, "fall into his fixed rut") as oil enters flour and cannot get out, and of both inherited gestures and current fashions as ruts: "killing buddhas and patriarchs" falls within the old people's enclosure, while wielding the staff and shout does not escape the present-day rut (殺佛殺祖，盡落古人圜繢；行棒行喝，不脫今時窠臼). One record pairs new and old while saying "jump out of the rut" (一新一舊，跳出窠臼). The decisive corpus warning is recursive: pupils may mistake a master's refusal to establish a rut and thereby make "no rut" into a rut (以無窠臼為窠臼, "take having no rut as a rut"). Thus the Chan deviation is not merely an ordinary habit: the term names repeatable religious speech, gestures, formats, and even anti-formulas once followers preserve them as a template.
Senses.Note: Count: 969 occurrences in 243 allowlisted texts. One corpus-wide figurative thing; nest and mortar supply the literal image but the curated Chan occurrences all denote a fixed pattern. No separate sense was made for old versus current patterns, which are different instances of the same thing.

Occurrences.Kwic: 墮他窠臼。如油入麵不得出頭。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 天目中峰廣錄, 示眾. Zhongfeng Mingben is the exact speaker: the complete address is his own instruction, and he says that students who do not distinguish good from bad fall into another person's rut like oil entering flour.

Occurrences.Kwic: 一新一舊，跳出窠臼。一出一入，胡餅裏呷汁。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷). Complete Book of the Five Lamps (五燈全書), Miyin Xianjie section. Miyin Xianjie is the exact hall speaker who says that one new and one old leap out of the old mold.

Occurrences.Kwic: 殺佛殺祖，盡落古人圜繢；行棒行喝，不脫今時窠臼。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Extensive Record of Chan Master Yongjue Yuanxian (永覺元賢禪師廣錄). An unnamed layman asks the exact public question contrasting an old enclosure with the present-day rut of staff and shout; all six attribution rungs leave him unnamed. Yongjue Yuanxian is the respondent and following speaker.

Occurrences.Kwic: 到這裏不拘格式。不躡前蹤。不昧當機。如何舉唱明眼漢沒窠臼。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 圓悟佛果禪師語錄. Yuanwu Keqin is the exact actor: his 上堂 says the clear-eyed person has no 窠臼.

Occurrences.Kwic: 雖不立窠臼露布，久之學徒妄認，亦成窠臼露布也。盖以無窠臼為窠臼
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 續古尊宿語要, Yuanwu Keqin's instruction to the scribe Yu. Yuanwu Keqin is the exact author: he warns that students turn even a great lineage teacher's refusal to establish a mold into another mold and make absence of a posted formula into a posted formula.
